name: Word Guess Race
tagline: One secret word. Six guesses. Race your friends.
description: Everyone solves the same five-letter English word on their own phone. Each accepted guess gives exact, misplaced and absent letter clues. Solve in fewer guesses than your friends, then faster if you tie. The TV shows progress without giving anyone's letters away.
howToPlay: Type a five-letter English word. You have six guesses per round.
Tick: right place. Arrow: another place. Cross: absent. Check your phone's letter clues.
Fewer guesses beats more; time breaks ties. Beat opponents for points across three rounds.
